# The Bandit job's tools: bandit with its built-in SARIF formatter, and everything it pulls in,
# pinned to exact versions AND hashes, for the job's Python (3.11, Linux; wheels only).
#
# That job holds `security-events: write`, and code-scanning alert state is what codeql-alerts.yml
# and codeql.yml's PR gate read as the truth. It installed `bandit bandit-sarif-formatter`
# unpinned, so whatever was newest on PyPI that day ran with that token in reach. Installed with
# `--require-hashes --only-binary :all:`: a new release, or a changed file under an old version
# number, is refused instead of run. bandit-sarif-formatter is gone - bandit has shipped a sarif
# formatter since 1.7.8; its two libraries (sarif-om, jschema-to-python) are the `sarif` extra.
# Dependabot proposes bumps (.github/dependabot.yml), hashes included.
